messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a PR to update the Localization > Region availability page. Main goals: sync the supported regions table, add a short migration snippet for the SDK v2 endpoint-override, and add a small residency note for EU customers. PR: #4123.

kevin: SG. Do you want the snippet to show `geo_endpoint` as an env var or passed directly to the client?

maria: Let's show both, but prioritise the env var pattern since that's what infra teams prefer. Short JS + Python examples only. Keep them minimal so they fit the code example card.

sahil: Heads-up from legal: the residency note needs to explicitly call out that 'data persistence' for logs and tokens may still be processed by control plane services in the region X — we should avoid implying full contractual residency unless a Private deployment is in place. I can suggest copy.

maria: Perfect — can you paste suggested wording? I want to avoid rewording in a follow-up commit.

sahil: Suggested line: "For hosted deployments, customer data (tokens, request metadata) may be routed through regional control planes; customers requiring contractual data residency should contact sales for Private deployment options." Use that verbatim.

kevin: Drafting the snippet now. Quick Q: do we still recommend `endpoint_map` helper or the new `REGIONAL_ENDPOINT` env var? I recall runtime maps are being deprecated.

maria: Recommend env var + show direct param. Add a one-liner: "If you rely on automatic routing, test in staging — automatic region routing can change per model version."

kevin: Here are the snippets I plan to add:
```js
// JS (node)
const endpoint = process.env.REGIONAL_ENDPOINT || 'api.redwood.ai';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ baseURL: `https://${endpoint}` });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'Translate to fr:' });
```

```py
# Python
import os
endpoint = os.getenv('REGIONAL_ENDPOINT', 'api.redwood.ai')
client = RedwoodClient(base_url=f"https://{endpoint}")
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-1', prompt='Translate to fr:')
```

linda: Tiny nit: please make the default example endpoint `api.redwood-inference.com` to match docs canonical domain (not internal shortname). Also add a short caption under each snippet: "Replace with your regional endpoint (see table above)."

maria: Good catch. I'll update the default host.

kevin: Also, the staging docs builder flagged an anchor rename — the endpoints table moved from `#region-availability` to `#supported-regions` which will break a few internal links. I'll update the `/examples/*` crosslinks in the PR.

maria: Thanks — can you also add a redirect note for the change? Something like: "Old anchors `#region-availability` now redirect to `#supported-regions`."

kevin: Done in the branch. I pushed a tiny commit and added a test link check in the CI job.

maria: @sahil — I included your residency wording in the doc text. Can you quick-review for legal tone? If ok, I'll request reviews from @linda and @kevin and merge.

sahil: Read and looks fine. Small tweak: change "contact sales" to "contact your account rep or sales". Otherwise :+1:.

maria: Changing now.

docs-bot: docs preview build available: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr/4123/abcdef (staging). Snapshot TTL 2 days.

linda: Preview looks good overall. Two micro nits: 1) table column header 'Residency' -> 'Data residency (hosted)'; 2) add an example row for 'APAC (singapore)' with the endpoint `sg-api.redwood-inference.com`.

maria: Will add both. Kevin — can you confirm the endpoint name for APAC?

kevin: Confirmed `sg-api.redwood-inference.com` is the public endpoint for singapore. I've added it to the endpoints YAML used by the docs build.

maria: Thanks everyone. Plan: merge after 1) @sahil quick-approval, 2) @linda final UX sign-off, 3) CI link-check passes. If no objections I'll cherry-pick to `stable-docs-v1` for the next patch release.

docs-bot: CI: link-check ✅, build ✅, accessibility check ⚠️ (contrast issue in the table header flagged).

linda: I'll fix the contrast color on the header in a follow-up commit (tiny CSS tweak). No blocker for content.

maria: Merging now. Will open a backport PR to `stable-docs-v1` and drop the CSS follow-up as a separate changelist. Thanks all :shipit:
